name: AgentTune free tools
privacy: Tool inputs are processed in the browser tab, without model calls, accounts, or automatic persistence. Explicit downloads and card share links contain user-selected content.

tools.name: Communication preferences builder
tools.description: Build custom AI instructions from your preferred tone, detail, feedback and format. No personality test or signup. Edit and export locally.

tools.name: Instruction checker
tools.description: Check custom instructions for duplicate lines, absolute rules and possible conflicts. Review specific suggestions and choose which duplicates to remove.

tools.name: Muse Soul.md editor
tools.description: Edit Muse Soul.md with a merge preview, original-file backup and undo. Preserve existing preferences and add an editable communication template.

tools.name: Instruction converter & merger
tools.description: Format your own instructions for ChatGPT, Claude, Muse, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or an API. Preview merges without replacing existing project context.

tools.name: Instruction test bench
tools.description: Compare AI answers before and after changing instructions. Use fixed probes, randomized A/B labels, word counts and your own ratings. Export results.

tools.name: Enneagram scoring playground
tools.description: Explore the 36-item Enneagram scorer: enter answers, see nine totals and ties, export JSON, and use the JavaScript scorer or React TypeScript starter.

tools.name: AI memory export reviewer
tools.description: Review AI memory exports locally. Edit entries, remove exact duplicates, flag sensitive details, redact common patterns and export selected memories.

tools.name: How to work with me card
tools.description: Create an editable how-to-work-with-me card for teammates or AI assistants. Choose what to share, export Markdown or create an optional share link.

destinations.name: Any chat · this conversation
destinations.help: Paste into a chat when you want these preferences used. This does not create saved memory.

destinations.name: ChatGPT · custom instructions
destinations.help: Review in Settings → Personalization → Custom instructions. Controls and limits can vary by client.

destinations.name: Claude · account instructions
destinations.help: Review in Claude’s account instructions. Use project instructions instead for project-specific context.

destinations.name: ChatGPT or Claude · project instructions
destinations.help: Add to the selected project’s instructions. Preserve the project’s existing context and requirements.

destinations.name: Muse · Soul.md
destinations.help: Review in Muse’s Assistant Identity settings. Soul.md describes communication style; keep personal facts in Memory.md.

destinations.name: Claude Code · CLAUDE.md
destinations.help: Merge into the intended project’s CLAUDE.md. Keep existing repository instructions. Review scope before saving.

destinations.name: Codex · AGENTS.md
destinations.help: Merge into AGENTS.md at the intended scope. A project file and personal instructions have different reach.

destinations.name: API · JSON instruction payload
destinations.help: Generic JSON with an instructions field. Adapt to your provider’s documented request schema; this is not a complete API request.
